HEADER: Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +15
Aura Aqua Dome (30-ft., water resistance reduction for 1d4 rounds, Will DC 20 negates)
DEFENSE: AC 22, touch 18, flat-footed 17 (+3 deflect, +4 dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)
Immune critical hits, poison, sneak attacks, water;
OFFENSE: At will (DC 15) - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic
5th (DC 20) - Drown, Geyser, Sleepja (DC 19), Spell Resistance, Waterga
STATISTICS: Str 10, Dex 18, Con 13, Int 18, Wis 14, Cha 16
Feats Alertness, Combat Casting, Dodge, Elemental Focus (Water), Empower Spell, Extend Spell, Silent Spell, Spell Penetration
Skills Acrobatics +17, Bluff +16, Escape Artist +17, Knowledge (arcana, nature) +17, Perception +15, Sense Motive +15, Spellcraft +17, Stealth +17
Languages Aquan, Slyvan, Undercommon + 1 other (DM's choice)
SPECIAL ABILITIES: All creatures within a 30-foot radius from grief witch must make a DC 20 Will save or have their water resistance dropped by 5 for 1d4 rounds. Whether or not the save is successful, that creature cannot be affected again by the same grief witch's aqua dome ability for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Once every 1d4 rounds, the grief wight can surround a creature in a thin layer of magically viscous water. A target that fails the Reflex save (DC 21) becomes entangled and must hold its breath or risk drowning. The target or an adjacent creature can spend a full-round action on its turn scraping off the clinging fluid, allowing a new Reflex save with a +2 bonus; otherwise, the effect lasts for 1d4 minutes. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 17).

A grief witch is always in liquid form. She gains immunity to critical hits, poison, and sneak attacks. She also has DR/10 magic. She retains her own base speed, and her swim speed doubles to 120 feet.
A grief witch adds her Charisma modifier as a racial bonus on all her saving throws and as a deflection bonus to her AC.

parsed.description: A spirit-type beast that appeared in the land flooded with the memories of people. It indiscriminately drains the life force of any living thing it comes across. Made up of the memories of women once called witches, it is held together by their pain and regret. A mere lump of souls with nowhere to go, it now wanders around looking to feed off the emotions of those with a strong desire to preserve their own lives.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
